en: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!
The shame of this…\nI'm red-faced…
Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!
Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!
This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…
GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!
Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…
Oh…\nMy feelings, they are blue…
The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.
I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.
Oh, my, so strong.
I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.
I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.
Oh, my goodness gracious!
A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.
I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!
Oops!\nI rushed things!
When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!
I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.
That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.
Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.
SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.
